EXTRAORDINARY
NOTICE UNDER SECTION 7 OF THE LAND
ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT. No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry’s No.: 4-3/6/2016/HW/179
My Reference No.: BER/4/5/5/09.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:- Description of the land for servitude to be acquired: Thirty four (34) allotments of land in total extent of 0.5328 Hectare Known as lot Nos. 1 to 34 in Preliminary Plan No. ක 4703 dated 07.08.2018 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at Grama Niladhari’s Division of 744A-Duwegoda in Divisional Secretariat Division of Beruwala in Kalutara District, Western Province More fully described as follows,
Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Dummalamodara, Thuduwewatta; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original; Claimant: Railway Reservation; Extent: 0.0002 Hectare.
Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Pinwatta alias Thalapathkandewatta; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not known; Extent: 0.0067 Hectare.
